# laravelforge Provider

Manage [Laravel Forge](https://forge.laravel.com) resources as code.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Forge API. Defaults to `https://forge.laravel.com`. May also be set via `FORGE_ENDPOINT`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Laravel Forge API token. May also be set via the `FORGE_TOKEN` environment variable.
